definitions.explanation: Focused on defense rather than offense; intended to protect against attack or criticism.

examples.japanese: {防御的|ぼうぎょてき}な{姿勢|しせい}を{取|と}る。
{彼|かれ}は{批判|ひはん}に{対|たい}して{防御的|ぼうぎょてき}になった。
examples.english: He became defensive in response to criticism.

examples.japanese: {防御的|ぼうぎょてき}な{戦略|せんりゃく}で{試合|しあい}に{臨|のぞ}んだ。
examples.english: They approached the match with a defensive strategy.

notes:
FORMS:
・{防御的|ぼうぎょてき}な + noun (adnominal)
・{防御的|ぼうぎょてき}に (adverbially)
・{防御的|ぼうぎょてき}だ (predicative)

FORMATION:
{防御|ぼうぎょ} (defense, protection) + {的|てき} (-like, -ic)

USAGE:
・{防御的|ぼうぎょてき}な{態度|たいど} (defensive attitude)
・{防御的|ぼうぎょてき}な{運転|うんてん} (defensive driving)
・{防御的|ぼうぎょてき}な{反応|はんのう} (defensive reaction)

CONTRAST:
・{攻撃的|こうげきてき} - aggressive, offensive (antonym)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{守備的|しゅびてき} - defensive (in sports contexts)
